svg.aria-label: Use case diagram: Student, Treasurer and SAS Admin are all Users who sign in, receive notifications and ask the assistant. Students view their dues and the Insights dashboards. Treasurers manage members, record payments which include issuing a receipt, file remittances and resolution requests, liquidate activities, export reports and message SAS. SAS Admin approves accounts, remittances, resolutions and liquidations, manages the school year, students and accredited list, makes corrections, views Insights and the activity log, and sends announcements.
